description: Pinned feature registry (conventions §6). FeatureVector.values follows this order; registry_hash is the FeatureVector feature_version.

features.name: ret_simple_1s_v1
features.doc: Simple mid-to-mid return over 1s: mid(t)/mid(t-1s) - 1 (mid sampled at-or-before t-1s).

features.name: ret_simple_5s_v1
features.doc: Simple mid-to-mid return over 5s: mid(t)/mid(t-5s) - 1 (mid sampled at-or-before t-5s).

features.name: ret_simple_10s_v1
features.doc: Simple mid-to-mid return over 10s: mid(t)/mid(t-10s) - 1 (mid sampled at-or-before t-10s).

features.name: ret_simple_30s_v1
features.doc: Simple mid-to-mid return over 30s: mid(t)/mid(t-30s) - 1 (mid sampled at-or-before t-30s).

features.name: ret_simple_1m_v1
features.doc: Simple mid-to-mid return over 1m: mid(t)/mid(t-1m) - 1 (mid sampled at-or-before t-1m).

features.name: ret_log_1s_v1
features.doc: Log mid return over 1s: ln mid(t) - ln mid(t-1s).

features.name: ret_log_5s_v1
features.doc: Log mid return over 5s: ln mid(t) - ln mid(t-5s).

features.name: ret_log_10s_v1
features.doc: Log mid return over 10s: ln mid(t) - ln mid(t-10s).

features.name: ret_log_30s_v1
features.doc: Log mid return over 30s: ln mid(t) - ln mid(t-30s).

features.name: ret_log_1m_v1
features.doc: Log mid return over 1m: ln mid(t) - ln mid(t-1m).

features.name: ret_accel_1s_v1
features.doc: Return acceleration over 1s: ret_log(t,1s) - ret_log(t-1s,1s).

features.name: ret_accel_5s_v1
features.doc: Return acceleration over 5s: ret_log(t,5s) - ret_log(t-5s,5s).

features.name: ret_accel_10s_v1
features.doc: Return acceleration over 10s: ret_log(t,10s) - ret_log(t-10s,10s).

features.name: ret_accel_30s_v1
features.doc: Return acceleration over 30s: ret_log(t,30s) - ret_log(t-30s,30s).

features.name: ret_accel_1m_v1
features.doc: Return acceleration over 1m: ret_log(t,1m) - ret_log(t-1m,1m).

features.name: ret_resid_1s_v1
features.doc: Residual log return over 1s vs the cross-asset reference: ret_log_1s - beta_w5m * ref_ret_1s.

features.name: ret_resid_5s_v1
features.doc: Residual log return over 5s vs the cross-asset reference: ret_log_5s - beta_w5m * ref_ret_5s.

features.name: ret_resid_10s_v1
features.doc: Residual log return over 10s vs the cross-asset reference: ret_log_10s - beta_w5m * ref_ret_10s.

features.name: ret_resid_30s_v1
features.doc: Residual log return over 30s vs the cross-asset reference: ret_log_30s - beta_w5m * ref_ret_30s.

features.name: ret_resid_1m_v1
features.doc: Residual log return over 1m vs the cross-asset reference: ret_log_1m - beta_w5m * ref_ret_1m.

features.name: mid_change_ticks_1s_v1
features.doc: Mid change over 1s in ticks: (mid_ticks(t) - mid_ticks(t-1s)).

features.name: mid_change_ticks_5s_v1
features.doc: Mid change over 5s in ticks: (mid_ticks(t) - mid_ticks(t-5s)).

features.name: mid_change_ticks_10s_v1
features.doc: Mid change over 10s in ticks: (mid_ticks(t) - mid_ticks(t-10s)).

features.name: mid_change_ticks_30s_v1
features.doc: Mid change over 30s in ticks: (mid_ticks(t) - mid_ticks(t-30s)).

features.name: mid_change_ticks_1m_v1
features.doc: Mid change over 1m in ticks: (mid_ticks(t) - mid_ticks(t-1m)).

features.name: ret_vol_adj_1s_v1
features.doc: Volatility-adjusted log return over 1s: ret_log_1s / (rvol_w1m + EPS).

features.name: ret_vol_adj_5s_v1
features.doc: Volatility-adjusted log return over 5s: ret_log_5s / (rvol_w1m + EPS).

features.name: ret_vol_adj_10s_v1
features.doc: Volatility-adjusted log return over 10s: ret_log_10s / (rvol_w1m + EPS).

features.name: ret_vol_adj_30s_v1
features.doc: Volatility-adjusted log return over 30s: ret_log_30s / (rvol_w1m + EPS).

features.name: ret_vol_adj_1m_v1
features.doc: Volatility-adjusted log return over 1m: ret_log_1m / (rvol_w1m + EPS).

features.name: mid_price_v1
features.doc: Consolidated mid price: (best_bid + best_ask)/2 * tick_size.

features.name: microprice_v1
features.doc: Size-weighted microprice: (Pb*Qa + Pa*Qb)/(Qb+Qa) * tick_size.

features.name: micro_mid_dev_bps_v1
features.doc: Microprice deviation from mid in bps: (microprice-mid)/mid*1e4.

features.name: spread_ticks_v1
features.doc: Consolidated quoted spread in ticks: best_ask - best_bid.

features.name: spread_bps_v1
features.doc: Quoted spread in bps of mid: spread_ticks*tick_size/mid*1e4.

features.name: depth_bid_l1_v1
features.doc: Summed bid size over the best 1 price level(s).

features.name: depth_ask_l1_v1
features.doc: Summed ask size over the best 1 price level(s).

features.name: depth_bid_l5_v1
features.doc: Summed bid size over the best 5 price level(s).

features.name: depth_ask_l5_v1
features.doc: Summed ask size over the best 5 price level(s).

features.name: depth_bid_l10_v1
features.doc: Summed bid size over the best 10 price level(s).

features.name: depth_ask_l10_v1
features.doc: Summed ask size over the best 10 price level(s).

features.name: depth_total_l1_v1
features.doc: Two-sided depth over the best 1 level(s): bid + ask.

features.name: depth_total_l5_v1
features.doc: Two-sided depth over the best 5 level(s): bid + ask.

features.name: depth_total_l10_v1
features.doc: Two-sided depth over the best 10 level(s): bid + ask.

features.name: depth_bid_l1_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_bid_l1 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: depth_ask_l1_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_ask_l1 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: depth_bid_l5_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_bid_l5 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: depth_ask_l5_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_ask_l5 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: depth_bid_l10_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_bid_l10 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: depth_ask_l10_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_ask_l10 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: depth_bid_l1_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_bid_l1 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: depth_ask_l1_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_ask_l1 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: depth_bid_l5_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_bid_l5 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: depth_ask_l5_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_ask_l5 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: depth_bid_l10_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_bid_l10 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: depth_ask_l10_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of depth_ask_l10 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: imbalance_l1_v1
features.doc: Depth imbalance over best 1 level(s): (b-a)/(b+a).

features.name: imbalance_l3_v1
features.doc: Depth imbalance over best 3 level(s): (b-a)/(b+a).

features.name: imbalance_l5_v1
features.doc: Depth imbalance over best 5 level(s): (b-a)/(b+a).

features.name: imbalance_l10_v1
features.doc: Depth imbalance over best 10 level(s): (b-a)/(b+a).

features.name: imbalance_l1_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of imbalance_l1 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: imbalance_l3_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of imbalance_l3 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: imbalance_l5_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of imbalance_l5 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: imbalance_l10_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean of imbalance_l10 sampled at book refreshes over 1s.

features.name: imbalance_l1_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of imbalance_l1 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: imbalance_l3_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of imbalance_l3 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: imbalance_l5_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of imbalance_l5 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: imbalance_l10_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean of imbalance_l10 sampled at book refreshes over 10s.

features.name: spread_ticks_avg_w1s_v1
features.doc: Mean quoted spread in ticks over 1s.

features.name: spread_ticks_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean quoted spread in ticks over 10s.

features.name: queue_depletion_rate_bid_w1s_v1
features.doc: L1 bid queue depletion rate over 1s: depleted qty per second.

features.name: queue_depletion_rate_ask_w1s_v1
features.doc: L1 ask queue depletion rate over 1s: depleted qty per second.

features.name: queue_depletion_rate_bid_w10s_v1
features.doc: L1 bid queue depletion rate over 10s: depleted qty per second.

features.name: queue_depletion_rate_ask_w10s_v1
features.doc: L1 ask queue depletion rate over 10s: depleted qty per second.

features.name: queue_replenish_rate_bid_w1s_v1
features.doc: L1 bid queue replenishment rate over 1s: added qty per second.

features.name: queue_replenish_rate_ask_w1s_v1
features.doc: L1 ask queue replenishment rate over 1s: added qty per second.

features.name: queue_replenish_rate_bid_w10s_v1
features.doc: L1 bid queue replenishment rate over 10s: added qty per second.

features.name: queue_replenish_rate_ask_w10s_v1
features.doc: L1 ask queue replenishment rate over 10s: added qty per second.

features.name: order_count_bid_l1_v1
features.doc: Resting order count at the best bid price (non-stale venues quoting that price).

features.name: order_count_ask_l1_v1
features.doc: Resting order count at the best ask price (non-stale venues quoting that price).

features.name: avg_order_size_bid_l1_v1
features.doc: Best-bid size divided by its resting order count.

features.name: avg_order_size_ask_l1_v1
features.doc: Best-ask size divided by its resting order count.

features.name: ofi_l1_w1s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 1 level(s), summed over 1s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 1.

features.name: ofi_l1_w5s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 1 level(s), summed over 5s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 1.

features.name: ofi_l1_w30s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 1 level(s), summed over 30s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 1.

features.name: ofi_l3_w1s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 3 level(s), summed over 1s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 3.

features.name: ofi_l3_w5s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 3 level(s), summed over 5s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 3.

features.name: ofi_l3_w30s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 3 level(s), summed over 30s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 3.

features.name: ofi_l5_w1s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 5 level(s), summed over 1s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 5.

features.name: ofi_l5_w5s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 5 level(s), summed over 5s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 5.

features.name: ofi_l5_w30s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 5 level(s), summed over 30s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 5.

features.name: ofi_l10_w1s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 10 level(s), summed over 1s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 10.

features.name: ofi_l10_w5s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 10 level(s), summed over 5s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 10.

features.name: ofi_l10_w30s_v1
features.doc: Order-flow imbalance over the best 10 level(s), summed over 30s: sum of per-event (bid depth delta - ask depth delta) within top 10.

features.name: ofi_norm_l1_w1s_v1
features.doc: ofi_l1_w1s normalized by the 10s mean two-sided depth over the best 1 level(s): ofi / (mean depth_total_l1 + EPS).

features.name: ofi_norm_l1_w5s_v1
features.doc: ofi_l1_w5s normalized by the 10s mean two-sided depth over the best 1 level(s): ofi / (mean depth_total_l1 + EPS).

features.name: ofi_norm_l1_w30s_v1
features.doc: ofi_l1_w30s normalized by the 10s mean two-sided depth over the best 1 level(s): ofi / (mean depth_total_l1 + EPS).

features.name: ofi_norm_l5_w1s_v1
features.doc: ofi_l5_w1s normalized by the 10s mean two-sided depth over the best 5 level(s): ofi / (mean depth_total_l5 + EPS).

features.name: ofi_norm_l5_w5s_v1
features.doc: ofi_l5_w5s normalized by the 10s mean two-sided depth over the best 5 level(s): ofi / (mean depth_total_l5 + EPS).

features.name: ofi_norm_l5_w30s_v1
features.doc: ofi_l5_w30s normalized by the 10s mean two-sided depth over the best 5 level(s): ofi / (mean depth_total_l5 + EPS).

features.name: signed_volume_w1s_v1
features.doc: Signed traded volume over 1s: +qty for buy-aggressor TRADEs (side=BID), -qty for sells.

features.name: signed_volume_w10s_v1
features.doc: Signed traded volume over 10s: +qty for buy-aggressor TRADEs (side=BID), -qty for sells.

features.name: signed_volume_w1m_v1
features.doc: Signed traded volume over 1m: +qty for buy-aggressor TRADEs (side=BID), -qty for sells.

features.name: trade_imbalance_w1s_v1
features.doc: Trade imbalance over 1s: (buy_qty - sell_qty)/(buy_qty + sell_qty).

features.name: trade_imbalance_w10s_v1
features.doc: Trade imbalance over 10s: (buy_qty - sell_qty)/(buy_qty + sell_qty).

features.name: trade_imbalance_w1m_v1
features.doc: Trade imbalance over 1m: (buy_qty - sell_qty)/(buy_qty + sell_qty).

features.name: trade_count_w1s_v1
features.doc: Number of TRADE events in 1s.

features.name: trade_count_w10s_v1
features.doc: Number of TRADE events in 10s.

features.name: trade_count_w1m_v1
features.doc: Number of TRADE events in 1m.

features.name: trade_intensity_w1s_v1
features.doc: TRADE events per second over 1s.

features.name: trade_intensity_w10s_v1
features.doc: TRADE events per second over 10s.

features.name: trade_intensity_w1m_v1
features.doc: TRADE events per second over 1m.

features.name: add_intensity_w1s_v1
features.doc: ADD events per second over 1s.

features.name: add_intensity_w10s_v1
features.doc: ADD events per second over 10s.

features.name: add_intensity_w1m_v1
features.doc: ADD events per second over 1m.

features.name: cancel_intensity_w1s_v1
features.doc: CANCEL events per second over 1s.

features.name: cancel_intensity_w10s_v1
features.doc: CANCEL events per second over 10s.

features.name: cancel_intensity_w1m_v1
features.doc: CANCEL events per second over 1m.

features.name: modify_intensity_w1s_v1
features.doc: MODIFY events per second over 1s.

features.name: modify_intensity_w10s_v1
features.doc: MODIFY events per second over 10s.

features.name: execute_intensity_w1s_v1
features.doc: EXECUTE events per second over 1s.

features.name: execute_intensity_w10s_v1
features.doc: EXECUTE events per second over 10s.

features.name: execute_intensity_w1m_v1
features.doc: EXECUTE events per second over 1m.

features.name: add_qty_w1s_v1
features.doc: Summed qty of ADD events over 1s.

features.name: add_qty_w10s_v1
features.doc: Summed qty of ADD events over 10s.

features.name: cancel_qty_w1s_v1
features.doc: Summed qty of CANCEL events over 1s.

features.name: cancel_qty_w10s_v1
features.doc: Summed qty of CANCEL events over 10s.

features.name: cancel_add_ratio_w1s_v1
features.doc: cancel_count / add_count over 1s (valid when adds > 0).

features.name: cancel_add_ratio_w10s_v1
features.doc: cancel_count / add_count over 10s (valid when adds > 0).

features.name: quoted_depth_total_v1
features.doc: Two-sided quoted depth over the best 10 levels.

features.name: quoted_depth_ratio_v1
features.doc: Bid share of two-sided top-10 depth: bid/(bid+ask).

features.name: quoted_depth_avg_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean two-sided top-10 quoted depth over 10s.

features.name: quoted_depth_avg_w1m_v1
features.doc: Mean two-sided top-10 quoted depth over 1m.

features.name: effective_spread_bps_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean effective spread over TRADEs in 10s: 2*|price-mid|/mid*1e4.

features.name: effective_spread_bps_w1m_v1
features.doc: Mean effective spread over TRADEs in 1m: 2*|price-mid|/mid*1e4.

features.name: traded_volume_w10s_v1
features.doc: Total TRADE qty over 10s.

features.name: traded_volume_w1m_v1
features.doc: Total TRADE qty over 1m.

features.name: participation_w10s_v1
features.doc: Trading activity vs liquidity over 10s: volume/(volume + mean quoted depth).

features.name: participation_w1m_v1
features.doc: Trading activity vs liquidity over 1m: volume/(volume + mean quoted depth).

features.name: depth_slope_bid_v1
features.doc: Book slope of the bid side: bps distance from L1 to L<=5 divided by the cumulative depth through that level.

features.name: depth_slope_ask_v1
features.doc: Book slope of the ask side: bps distance from L1 to L<=5 divided by the cumulative depth through that level.

features.name: resiliency_halflife_v1
features.doc: Seconds to rebuild half the current L1 depth at the 10s replenishment rate: ln(2)*(Qb+Qa)/2 / (rep_rate_10s + EPS).

features.name: rvol_w10s_v1
features.doc: Realized vol over 10s: sqrt(sum dlm^2 / 10s in seconds).

features.name: rvol_w1m_v1
features.doc: Realized vol over 1m: sqrt(sum dlm^2 / 1m in seconds).

features.name: rvol_w5m_v1
features.doc: Realized vol over 5m: sqrt(sum dlm^2 / 5m in seconds).

features.name: volofvol_w5m_v1
features.doc: Std of squared mid-change log returns over 5m (vol-of-vol proxy).

features.name: mean_abs_ret_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean |dlm| per mid change over 10s.

features.name: mean_abs_ret_w1m_v1
features.doc: Mean |dlm| per mid change over 1m.

features.name: range_bps_w10s_v1
features.doc: High-low mid range over 10s in bps of current mid.

features.name: range_bps_w1m_v1
features.doc: High-low mid range over 1m in bps of current mid.

features.name: range_bps_w5m_v1
features.doc: High-low mid range over 5m in bps of current mid.

features.name: jump_flag_w1m_v1
features.doc: 1 if max|dlm| over 1m > 4.0x mean|dlm| over 1m (>= 30 mid changes).

features.name: jump_count_w5m_v1
features.doc: Number of threshold jumps (|dlm| > 4.0x prevailing 1m mean|dlm|) detected in the last 5m.

features.name: vol_ratio_w10s_w1m_v1
features.doc: rvol_w10s / (rvol_w1m + EPS): short-vs-medium vol ratio.

features.name: vol_ratio_w1m_w5m_v1
features.doc: rvol_w1m / (rvol_w5m + EPS): medium-vs-long vol ratio.

features.name: minute_of_day_v1
features.doc: Minutes since UTC midnight (fractional).

features.name: session_frac_v1
features.doc: Fraction of the configured session elapsed, clipped to [0,1].

features.name: is_open_phase_v1
features.doc: 1 during the first 30 session minutes.

features.name: is_close_phase_v1
features.doc: 1 during the last 30 session minutes.

features.name: is_trading_v1
features.doc: 1 when no venue reports HALT or AUCTION.

features.name: is_auction_v1
features.doc: 1 when any venue reports AUCTION (and none HALT).

features.name: is_halt_v1
features.doc: 1 when any venue reports HALT.

features.name: norm_volume_m5_v1
features.doc: traded_volume_w1m normalized by its expanding 5-minute-of-day session profile mean (>= 10 prior observations).

features.name: norm_spread_m5_v1
features.doc: spread_bps normalized by its expanding 5-minute-of-day session profile mean.

features.name: norm_vol_m5_v1
features.doc: rvol_w1m normalized by its expanding 5-minute-of-day session profile mean.

features.name: norm_depth_m5_v1
features.doc: quoted_depth_total normalized by its expanding 5-minute-of-day session profile mean.

features.name: ref_ret_1s_v1
features.doc: Reference-instrument (ETF / EUR/USD) log mid return over 1s (lead-lag input).

features.name: ref_ret_5s_v1
features.doc: Reference-instrument (ETF / EUR/USD) log mid return over 5s (lead-lag input).

features.name: ref_ret_10s_v1
features.doc: Reference-instrument (ETF / EUR/USD) log mid return over 10s (lead-lag input).

features.name: ref_ret_30s_v1
features.doc: Reference-instrument (ETF / EUR/USD) log mid return over 30s (lead-lag input).

features.name: ref_ret_1m_v1
features.doc: Reference-instrument (ETF / EUR/USD) log mid return over 1m (lead-lag input).

features.name: beta_w5m_v1
features.doc: OLS beta of own vs reference contemporaneous 1s log returns over 5m: cov(x,y)/var(y).

features.name: corr_contemp_w1m_v1
features.doc: Correlation of own vs reference contemporaneous 1s log returns over 1m (FX: correlation proxy vs EUR/USD).

features.name: corr_contemp_w5m_v1
features.doc: Correlation of own vs reference contemporaneous 1s log returns over 5m (FX: correlation proxy vs EUR/USD).

features.name: leadlag_corr_w1m_v1
features.doc: Correlation of own 1s return vs reference 1s return lagged 1s over 1m (positive = reference leads).

features.name: leadlag_corr_w5m_v1
features.doc: Correlation of own 1s return vs reference 1s return lagged 1s over 5m (positive = reference leads).

features.name: resid_vol_w1m_v1
features.doc: Std of the beta-residual 1s return over 1m: sqrt(max(var(x) - cov^2/var(y), 0)).

features.name: venue_count_active_v1
features.doc: Number of venues with a two-sided, non-stale book.

features.name: venue_depth_hhi_v1
features.doc: HHI of per-venue shares of two-sided top-10 depth.

features.name: venue_update_hhi_w10s_v1
features.doc: HHI of per-venue event-count shares over 10s.

features.name: venue_update_share_top_w10s_v1
features.doc: Largest per-venue event-count share over 10s.

features.name: venue_staleness_max_ms_v1
features.doc: Max over venues of ms since that venue's last event.

features.name: venue_staleness_min_ms_v1
features.doc: Min over venues of ms since that venue's last event.

features.name: venue_staleness_spread_ms_v1
features.doc: Staleness spread: max - min venue staleness in ms.

features.name: venue_imbalance_divergence_v1
features.doc: Max - min of per-venue L1 imbalance across active venues.

features.name: venue_best_depth_share_bid_v1
features.doc: Largest single-venue share of the consolidated best-bid size.

features.name: venue_best_depth_share_ask_v1
features.doc: Largest single-venue share of the consolidated best-ask size.

features.name: trend_score_w10s_v1
features.doc: Normalized drift over 10s: ret_log / (rvol_w10s * sqrt(w_s) + EPS).

features.name: trend_score_w1m_v1
features.doc: Normalized drift over 1m: ret_log / (rvol_w1m * sqrt(w_s) + EPS).

features.name: trend_score_w5m_v1
features.doc: Normalized drift over 5m: ret_log / (rvol_w5m * sqrt(w_s) + EPS).

features.name: meanrev_score_w10s_v1
features.doc: Mean-reversion z-score over 10s: -(mid - mean)/(std + EPS).

features.name: meanrev_score_w1m_v1
features.doc: Mean-reversion z-score over 1m: -(mid - mean)/(std + EPS).

features.name: meanrev_score_w5m_v1
features.doc: Mean-reversion z-score over 5m: -(mid - mean)/(std + EPS).

features.name: vol_regime_flag_v1
features.doc: 1 when rvol_w1m > rvol_w5m (elevated short-term vol).

features.name: vol_regime_ratio_v1
features.doc: rvol_w1m / (rvol_w5m + EPS).

features.name: liq_regime_flag_v1
features.doc: 1 when current quoted depth exceeds its 1m mean.

features.name: liq_regime_ratio_v1
features.doc: quoted_depth_total / (mean quoted depth over 1m + EPS).

features.name: fill_prob_bid_h1s_v1
features.doc: P(back-of-L1-bid-queue order fills within 1s): 1 - exp(-depletion_rate_bid_w10s * h_s / Q_bid_L1).

features.name: fill_prob_ask_h1s_v1
features.doc: P(back-of-L1-ask-queue order fills within 1s): 1 - exp(-depletion_rate_ask_w10s * h_s / Q_ask_L1).

features.name: fill_prob_bid_h10s_v1
features.doc: P(back-of-L1-bid-queue order fills within 10s): 1 - exp(-depletion_rate_bid_w10s * h_s / Q_bid_L1).

features.name: fill_prob_ask_h10s_v1
features.doc: P(back-of-L1-ask-queue order fills within 10s): 1 - exp(-depletion_rate_ask_w10s * h_s / Q_ask_L1).

features.name: half_spread_cost_bps_v1
features.doc: Immediate crossing cost: spread_bps / 2.

features.name: expected_impact_bps_v1
features.doc: Impact proxy: half_spread_bps * sqrt(1 + traded_volume_w10s / (quoted_depth_total + EPS)).

features.name: alpha_decay_proxy_v1
features.doc: Information arrival speed: rvol_w10s / (rvol_w1m + EPS).

features.name: urgency_score_v1
features.doc: Urgency to act: |imbalance_l1| * alpha_decay_proxy / (1 + spread_ticks).
